### Fixed
- **`make verify-gpu-pool` passes on a `GOLDEN_REF` that carries `modelServing.gpuPool`** (#482). The untainted case asserts the serving render is byte-identical to `GOLDEN_REF` (`origin/main` by default) but for the discovery block — with the golden rendered at its own defaults. From the commit that merged #482 onto main that golden is *tainted*, so an untainted head could never equal it and `test-ingress-modes` failed on every branch cut from main, main included. The golden now takes the same `modelServing.gpuPool.taint.key=` override when its `values.yaml` declares the key, and the discovery block is cut from both sides: the assertion is that equal inputs render alike, which is what it was always meant to be. A golden from before #482 still renders at its defaults, unchanged.
